blocks.text: Cheez centripetal force ki wajah se daire mein chalti hai. Agar lagne wali force zaroori centripetal force se kam ho to cheez daire ke centre se door (bahar) chali jati hai. Centrifuge (Fig. 3.8a) isi principle (qaida) par kaam karta hai.

blocks.alt: Mez par rakhne wala safed laboratory centrifuge; is ka gehra grey dhakkan peeche ki taraf khula hai. Andar gol grey chamber mein neele dhakkan wali sample tubes daire mein lagi hain. Saamne neela control panel hai jis par chhota display aur teen button hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.8(a): Laboratory ka centrifuge (kitab ki Figure 3.8(a) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Centrifuge: laboratory ka bohat kaam ka device. Yeh mixture mein se bhari (denser) aur halke particles alag karta hai. Mixture ko kuch waqt tak bohat tez ghumaya jata hai. Sample tubes mein bhari particles tube ke bottom mein beth jate hain aur halke particles oopar aa jate hain (Fig. 3.8b).

blocks.alt: Vertical shaft par hub aur do horizontal baazu. Har baazu ke sire par holder ek sample tube pakarta hai jo bahar ki taraf leti hai, us ka band gol sira shaft se door. Shaft ke gird mura teer rotation (ghoomna) dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.8(b): Centrifuge ki sample tubes, jin mein denser particles bottom par baith jate hain (kitab ki Figure 3.8(b) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Ghoomte waqt tubes bahar ki taraf letti hain. Bhari particles ko daire mein rakhne ke liye zyada centripetal force chahiye; jab yeh kafi nahi milti to woh bahar, yani tube ke band sire (bottom) ki taraf chale jate hain.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Washing machine ka dryer bhi centrifuge ke principle par chalta hai. Is mein ek lamba cylinder hota hai jis ki deewar mein saikron chhote soorakh hote hain. Geele kapre is mein dal kar cylinder ko apne axis par tezi se ghumaya jata hai. Pani bahar deewaron ki taraf jata hai aur soorakhon se nikal jata hai; yun kapre jaldi sookh jate hain.

blocks.alt: Gol safed spin dryer, thora oopar se dekha hua; is ka safed dhakkan peeche khula hai aur munh ke gird maroon (gehra laal) kinara hai. Andar chhote chhote suraakhon wala drum hai jis mein kuch geele kapre hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.9: Washing machine ka dryer (kitab ki Figure 3.9 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Cream separator doodh se cream alag karne ka device hai. Is mein doodh ko tezi se ghumaya jata hai. Doodh halke aur bhari particles ka mixture hai; ghumane par halke particles (cream) axis ke qareeb jama hote hain aur bhari particles bahar chale jate hain, is liye cream aasani se alag ho jati hai.

blocks.alt: Cream separator: oopar doodh ke liye chaura chandi-rang (silver) bowl, us ke neeche silver separator head jis se do mure hue paip (spouts) baayen taraf nikalte hain, saath neela motor ka dabba, aur neeche teen phaili hui taangon par neela gol stand.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.10: Cream separator (kitab ki Figure 3.10 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.prompt: 0.5 m lambi dori zyada se zyada 35.6 N tension sah sakti hai. 0.5 kg ka patthar is dori se vertical daire mein zyada se zyada kis speed se ghumaya ja sakta hai? Aur car ke liye tez speed par morna mushkil kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Tension daire ke sab se neeche wale point par sab se zyada hoti hai, jahan T − mg = mv²/r. To 35.6 − 0.5 × 9.8 = 0.5 × v² / 0.5, yani v² = 30.7 aur v ≈ 5.5 m s⁻¹. Car ke liye zaroori centripetal force mv²/r speed ke square ke saath barhti hai; tez speed par tyres ki friction kafi nahi rehti aur car phisal jati hai.

items: Velocity ke perpendicular force sirf direction badalti hai: centripetal force F꜀ = mv²/r = mrω², radius ke saath centre ki taraf. Force khatam ho to object tangent par seedha chala jata hai.
Vertical daire ke top par: T = m(v²/r − g). Example 3.2: CD ke rim par a ≈ 29 m s⁻².
Centripetal force dene wale: dori ki tension, friction (turntable, tyres), gravity (orbits), magnetic force; tez moron par banked sarkein.
Istemal: centrifuge, washing machine ka dryer, cream separator.
